title: User function body — bounded for-loop over local vector, per-iteration bit write — pass 24
sourceUrl: internal: Tier 4.3 pass 24 for-loop in fn body
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Function body has a bounded for-loop over local variable `r`. Each iteration writes `r(i) := x(i) xor z(i)`. Pass 24 accepts ForLoopStructure as a fn-body prefix task by delegating to ProcessSynthesizer.WalkTasks (pass-10 unroll machinery). This closes the pass-20 non-goal 'return-in-loop' for the subset that has no return inside the loop.
